title: Sebastian and the Gravity
author: Coral Crane
blurb: Cyrus Ishikawa, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
